verdict.rationale: The evidence shows alert rules can be created and that prebuilt dashboards exist, but nothing documents defining dashboards or alerts as code through JSON models, Terraform, or a provisioning API. The ES|QL REST API is for running queries, not for provisioning dashboards or rules, so it is only adjacent. This axis clearly applies to an observability platform, so the lack of evidence makes the verdict none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define dashboards and alerts as code (JSON models, Terraform, or API) and provision them repeatably
